profile.headline: Software Engineer III @ Walmart Global Tech | Backend | Java | Spring Boot | Kubernetes | Distributed Systems | Kafka | RAG
profile.summary:
I build the backend infrastructure that keeps high-scale systems running reliably, efficiently, and at Walmart scale.

At Walmart Global Tech, I design microservices, event-driven pipelines, and developer platforms used by thousands of daily users. I've redesigned cron-based ingestion into near-real-time event-driven architectures, engineered auth layers for Camunda workflows, and shipped production tooling that teams rely on daily.

What I bring:
High-scale distributed systems (Kafka, Kubernetes, 200K+ events/year)
SRE mindset: 99.99% availability, on-call, Grafana/Splunk-driven MTTR reduction
Full-stack when it counts: React + TypeScript dashboards shipped end-to-end
AI-augmented development, shipping production-ready tools in under 2 weeks

Passionate about RAG pipelines, platform engineering, and developer experience. Always happy to connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
People AI RAG Platform


- Designed and implemented core components of an experimentation integration layer for an internal platform serving 39K daily active users, including experiment APIs and a traffic proxy enabling resilient A/B testing through routing and failure isolation.
- Redesigned a cron-based ingestion system into an event-driven pipeline, reducing latency from 12 hours to near real-time by triggering PDF ingestion from GCS, chunking documents, and indexing content into a vector database for scalable RAG queries.
- Operated and supported distributed backend services behind a 99.99% availability gateway, participating in production on-call rotation and diagnosing Kubernetes-level failures under live traffic.
- Investigated production performance bottlenecks and service degradations using Grafana and Splunk, reducing MTTR and helping prevent cascading service failures.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
People API Gateway Team/ People Workflow Platform

- Engineered a secure, fault-tolerant authentication layer using Java and Spring Boot, persisting and querying service accounts in a relational database to protect Camunda workflows across 4+ endpoints.
- Designed and deployed Kafka-based event pipelines processing 200K+ events annually, enabling reliable asynchronous job orchestration across distributed microservices.
- Developed and deployed a React + TypeScript dashboard in 2 weeks, visualizing 50+ deployed workflows and giving product owners real-time visibility into workflow progress and totals, reducing lookup time from minutes to seconds.
- Led a zero-downtime domain transfer, migrating repositories, updating configurations, and building pipelines to integrate 30+ data fields across systems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Developed an associate query using GraphQL and created functionality through TypeScript,
being able to view over 2 million employees, resulting in more secure information
•Performed comprehensive vulnerability checks on TypeScript codebase, utilizing MochaJS
test cases to identify and address potential security issues and achieving 85% overall code
coverage
•Implemented role-based access restrictions for GraphQL fields, ensuring users were denied
access when searching specific fields beyond their authorized roles
•Collaborated with team members to design and implement a role-based access control
system, leveraging a sequential architecture to help build a more fluid system
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Agile Methodologies · Microsoft Office · GraphQL · GitHub · Mocha (JavaScript Framework) · Git · Node.js

positions.title: Part Time Student- Software/Data Engineering
positions.description:
•Conducted data pipeline development & maintenance following CI/CD practices to better
optimize the code base
•Converted and developed over 10 Jenkins files to YAML, consolidating processes into
GitHub and significantly enhancing overall efficiency for developers
•Co-led the development of a dashboard to monitor the health and use of internal web
services APIs with React and TypeScript used by 100+ developers
•Presented a demo to 80+ employees on converting Jenkins to GitHub Actions, emphasizing
the smoother and more efficient workflow of GitHub Actions
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Web Development · AWS · GitHub · NextJs · Data Management · DevOps · Git
